top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed swaddled in a blanket while being held by a caregiver.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection, certain areas of the center exhibited low temperatures. Two thermostats indicated readings of 60 degrees and 64 degrees, while the external temperature was recorded at below 40 degrees.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Written Operational Policies - Setting (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During inspection, Operational Policies did not state in which setting physical activity will be held.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The van for transportation does not have a child safety alarm equipped.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The documentation provided indicates that the center has not been completing its weekly and monthly maintenance outdoor checks.
